quizName: DMV Practice Test #4 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When riding, where should your feet be?
questions.explanation: Keep your feet on the footrests while riding. This helps you maintain balance.

questions.question: Why is a flat front tire especially dangerous?

options.text: The front tire affects your steering, which also affects your balance.
A flat front tire will disable the front brake.
A flat front tire will prevent you from accelerating.

questions.correctAnswerText: The front tire affects your steering, which also affects your balance.
questions.explanation: A flat front tire makes steering difficult. Good steering is essential for balance. If steering feels heavy, you may have a flat front tire.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It has white background with red and black markings. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When riding behind a car in the left third of the lane, the driver can see you in their side mirror. What is the problem with this position?

options.text: Most drivers do not check their side mirrors as often as their rearview mirror.
Wind may prevent the side mirror from working.
Drivers should never use their side mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Most drivers do not check their side mirrors as often as their rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Most drivers check their rearview mirror more often than their side mirrors. Ride in the center of the lane to be most visible in the driver's rearview mirror.

questions.question: When should you wear reflective clothing?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen in daylight. Wear brightly-colored, reflective clothing at all times when riding, day or night.

questions.question: What should you do if someone is tailgating you?

options.text: Change lanes to let them pass, or slow down to create more space ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes to let them pass, or slow down to create more space ahead.
questions.explanation: Ride in a way that encourages the tailgater to pass. Speeding up only makes them tailgate you at higher speeds, which is more dangerous.

questions.question: When stopping, which brakes should you use?
questions.explanation: Use both the front and rear brakes every time you slow down or stop.

questions.question: Since most crashes happen in daylight, what should you wear?

options.text: You do not need brightly-colored clothing during the day.
You should wear brightly-colored clothing during the day.
You should wear dark clothing during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: You should wear brightly-colored clothing during the day.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen in daylight. Wear brightly-colored clothing when riding, even during the day, to be more noticeable.

questions.question: What is the best way to prevent fatigue on a long trip?

options.text: Limit how much you ride each day.

questions.correctAnswerText: Limit how much you ride each day.
questions.explanation: Take frequent breaks to rest on long trips, even if you don't feel tired. Most experienced riders limit their riding to six hours per day. Wind, cold, and rain make you tired faster, so dress to protect yourself from the elements.

questions.question: When traveling at night, how difficult is it to judge distances?

options.text: It is easier to judge distances than during the day.
It is about the same as during the day.
It is more difficult to judge distances than during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is more difficult to judge distances than during the day.
questions.explanation: Judging distances at night is harder than during the day. Shadows and light help you see how far away objects are. At night, artificial lighting may distort or remove these helpful shadows and contrasts.

questions.question: What is the best way to help others see your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Always keep your headlight on while riding. Most motorcycles made after 1978 turn on the headlight automatically when the engine runs. Check that your headlight works before every ride.

questions.question: What is the best footwear for motorcyclists?
questions.explanation: Leather boots give the best foot protection. Choose boots that are high and sturdy to cover and support your ankles.

questions.question: If a motorcycle rider takes a turn too fast, what may happen?

options.text: Have increased control of their motorcycle.

questions.explanation: Taking a turn too fast can cause you to lose control. Your motorcycle may cross into another lane or go off the road.

questions.question: What is the safest part of the lane?

options.text: Is always the left portion of the lane.
Is always the right portion of the lane.

questions.explanation: There is no single best position in the lane. Change your position based on what is happening around you.

questions.question: If you reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time as another vehicle, what should happen?

options.text: The vehicle on the left should yield to the vehicle on the right.
You should flash your headlight to signal that the other vehicle should proceed.
You should continue through the intersection and expect the other vehicle to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left should yield to the vehicle on the right.
questions.explanation: At an uncontrolled intersection with no signs or lights, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right.

questions.question: What should you consider first when buying a motorcycle helmet?
questions.explanation: Protection is most important. Choose a helmet that fits well, fastens securely, and has a DOT safety rating.

questions.question: What should you do to reduce the chances of a collision?

options.text: Focus only on your riding, not on your surroundings.

questions.explanation: Bright or reflective clothing makes you more visible to other drivers and lowers your risk of a collision. Always be aware of the drivers around you.

questions.question: When riding during the day, what should you wear?

options.text: Wear dark clothes since it is light outside.
Wear bright clothes so other motorists can see you better.
Be comfortable, wearing shorts if it is hot.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear bright clothes so other motorists can see you better.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day. Always wear bright clothing when riding, even in daylight, so other drivers can see you better.

questions.question: What is needed for eye or face shield protection to work well?

options.text: Restrict your vision to the sides so you can focus on the road ahead.
Not allow eyeglasses or sunglasses to be worn.

questions.explanation: A good eye or face shield must have no scratches, resist breaking, allow clear views to both sides, fasten securely, let air pass through to prevent fogging, and allow room for eyeglasses or sunglasses if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: As you approach a blind intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Position your motorcycle so other drivers can see you as early as possible.
Move to the part of the lane closest to the traffic control device.
Move to the outside edge of the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Position your motorcycle so other drivers can see you as early as possible.
questions.explanation: At a blind intersection, position yourself in the lane so other drivers can see you as soon as possible.

questions.question: When does a motorcycle have less traction for braking?

options.text: When a motorcycle is straight up and down.
When a motorcycle is on dry pavement.

questions.explanation: A leaning motorcycle has less traction available for braking. During turns or curves, you must brake carefully and use extra caution.

questions.question: What happens when alcohol and drugs are used together?

options.text: They are less dangerous than using either one alone.
Their effects can be stronger than using either one alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Their effects can be stronger than using either one alone.
questions.explanation: Many drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter medications, can impair your riding ability. When combined with alcohol, some medications become even more dangerous.

questions.question: If vehicles are on both sides of your motorcycle, which lane position is usually safest?
questions.explanation: The best lane position depends on road and traffic conditions. When vehicles are on both sides of you, the center lane position is usually the safest choice.

questions.question: When choosing a helmet, what should you check?

options.text: It has no cracks or defects.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has no cracks or defects.
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards. It should fit snugly all the way around and have no visible damage like cracks, loose padding, or frayed straps.
